title: tc-clarifying-questions
description: The agent asks before it starts: two or three questions – choices, a short answer, "You decide" – sent back as one reply.

questions.description: The questions, in the order they're asked

value.description: The answers so far, by question id – the value

heading.description: Names the questions, as the agent says it

intro.description: What the agent will do once it knows, in a sentence under the heading

sent.description: The answers have been sent: the card shows them as the reply

decideLabel.description: The label of the answer that leaves a question to the agent

skipLabel.description: The label of the button that leaves every question to the agent

skippable.description: Offers the skip button; set it to false when the agent can't go on without answers

prompt.description: The question, as the agent asks it

kind.description: "single" – one choice, "multiple" – several, "text" – a short answer

options.description: The choices for single and multiple

hint.description: Why the agent asks, in a line under the question

description.description: A second line under the label – questions with descriptions show their answers as cards

ClarifyingAnswer.description: One question's answer: the picked values, the text, or "you decide"
